iEEGCoordinateSystemDescription: Talairach coordinates obtained via the LOC (Location on Cortex) package. The authors' LOC code (get_loc.m, get_loc_aplat.m in the library's loc folder) states: "this function is to determine electrode locations in talairach coordinates from x-ray". Coordinate length unit is not explicitly stated in reviewed source documentation; mm is assumed by Talairach convention, not confirmed.
